label: current-11

arguments.script: const invoices = session.get('invoices'); const result = []; for (const inv of invoices.filter(i => i.status === 'open' && i.dueDate < '2026-10-23')) { const customer = await call('billing.get_customer', {id:inv.customerId}); result.push({invoice:inv,customer}); } session.set('eligibleChecks',result); return result;

finalAnswer:
Created reminder drafts for open invoices due before 2026-10-23. No messages sent.

| Invoice ID | Draft ID |
|---|---|
| inv-11-a | draft-11-1 |
| inv-11-e | draft-11-2 |
| inv-11-f | draft-11-3 |

Skipped:
- inv-11-c — customer opted out of contact.
- inv-11-b — paid.
- inv-11-d — due after cutoff.
- inv-11-g — due on cutoff, not before.

Uncertain outcomes: none.
